gist.summary: `polli usage --daily` now honors an explicitly supplied `--limit N` or `--limit=N`, truncating rows after model and key filtering. Without the flag, daily output still includes every matching row; invalid limits are rejected unless they are positive integers. `--history` still uses its default limit of 20. Usage tests now account for Commander option state persisting across parses.
